what: This is one of several preferred unit series of Brookfield Property Partners, the global property owner with offices, shopping centres, hotels, logistics and residential assets. It pays a fixed distribution ahead of ordinary units but behind all debt.
customers: The properties serve office and retail tenants, hotel guests and residents; this security is bought by income investors.
money: rent from offices and shopping centres
moat: Prime properties in major cities under Brookfield management, whose capital markets access has kept these distributions being paid through a severe office downturn.
risks: Office values have fallen sharply since 2020
Consolidated debt is very large relative to the equity beneath these units
Revenue fell about 22% last year as assets were sold
The distribution is discretionary and ranks behind every lender
opportunities: Paid before ordinary unitholders receive anything
Logistics and retail assets have performed better than the office portfolio
watch: Asset sales, debt levels, and continued payment of the preferred distribution.
